people.name: Jehoram of Judah
people.note: Source had born 801 BC, died 843 BC (born after his own death). 2 Kgs 8:17: aged 32 at accession (852 BC), reigned 8 years.

people.name: Ahaziah of Judah
people.note: Source had born 821 BC, died 843 BC, and so was born before his father. 2 Kgs 8:26: aged 22 at accession (844 BC), reigned 1 year.

people.name: Samson
people.note: Source had born 1089 BC, died 1100 BC. Judges gives no age, so the birth year is cleared rather than guessed.

people.name: Amram
people.note: Source had born 1570 BC, the same year as his son Moses and after Aaron (1573 BC). Cleared rather than guessed.

art.title: Adam and Eve Driven out of Eden
art.note: The expulsion is told in the account of the Fall, not in the creation of Adam and Eve.

art.title: Jesus converses with the learned ones
art.note: Jesus among the teachers is the boy in the Temple (Luke 2), not the presentation.

art.title: Cain and Abel Offering their Sacrifices
art.note: Their offerings come before the killing; shown with the people instead of the event.

art.title: Adam and Eve expelled from Paradise
art.note: The same engraving as "Adam and Eve Driven out of Eden", scanned differently; the automatic check could not tell.
